1933, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 92 Cont.
Feb. Raymond Sabourin - 18 - on crutches - had crooked leg - now straight but weak
Desrie D. - 51 - operated weeks ago - home now & better but fears other operation - double apendix.
Feb. 22 Rose McDonald wants place for her sister - 30 - good worker - daily communicant, etc.
Mrs. De Witt - 35 - nerveous . Mrs. Beatrice Koloran - 24 - husband & two - Goiter ...
Lillie O'Neil - 1 groth Rachel Ryher - Goiter Mrs. Trebbey - 57 - (25.)
Mrs. Lottie Wasilewski - 36 - Husband & 6 boys - one in seminary, - 2nd wants to be a Br. - fears operation
Gilbert Hoffman. ...
Page 93 Blank Page
Page 94 Feb. Miss Pelerim - 70 - fearful tumors all over her breast - a member of III. O. since 1885
Mrs. Josephine Campbell - 44 - husband & daughter - internal cancer. Beatrice Lynch - 25 - candidate for Dom. Sister - had to leave novi- tiate on account of rhumatism - wants to get back.
Mrs. Daisy Chmielewski - 46 - gall trouble
Mrs. P. - 50 - Rhumatism
Mary Accuso - 54 - serious Stomach Tro. - Diabetis. . ..
